The Trail Blazers (7-3, third in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, eighth in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, second in the Northwest and sixth in the West) in Portland's 11th game of the season. Portland is riding a one-game winning streak with a 2-2 home record, while Oklahoma City is 5-0 at home and coming off a loss in its most recent game.

Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (foot bruise), Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), and Oklahoma City is without Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee).

Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 123-103 win in Portland on November 10, and the Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
